prior_outcomes_observed: ResNet, distillation, ordinal, regression, graph, relief and distributional source outcomes; independent dairy data were also previously evaluated with ResNet representations
hypothesis: With few independent animal groups, a frozen self-supervised encoder and an episode-consensus regional descriptor may be more useful than copying a small supervised depth teacher. Test the regional descriptor against the same encoder with global, fixed-centre, frame-local and low-similarity controls.
encoder: Official DINOv2 ViT-S/14, no registers, frozen; exact source commit and checkpoint SHA256 recorded in models/dinov2/acquisition.json
input: Native RGB or frame-normalised numeric depth independently letterboxed to 224x224; no RGB-depth pixel alignment used; ImageNet channel mean/std; depth repeated to three channels
patch_validity: Patch centres must lie within the resized original image area, excluding letterbox padding
centre_anchor: Patch centres within x=0.35..0.65 and y=0.15..0.85 of the resized native image; uniform mean of L2-normalised patch tokens, normalised to unit length
episode_anchor: Unit-normalised mean of all available frame centre anchors in that episode; no labels or other episodes used
consensus_pool: Select top 25 percent of valid patch tokens by cosine similarity to the episode anchor, uniform average, normalise. No frame or target event is rejected. This is a regional descriptor, not a validated anatomical segmentation.
controls: CLS only; CLS plus global valid-token mean; CLS plus fixed centre-token mean; CLS plus top-25-percent frame-local anchor; CLS plus bottom-25-percent episode similarity; RGB/depth global and consensus fusion
episode_aggregation: L2 normalise each frame CLS and pooled vector; average across the same maximum 12 unique frames; L2 normalise each episode component; concatenate components with equal energy
primary_RGBD_contrast: DINO_RGBD_consensus_SVR versus DINO_RGBD_global_SVR; not a training-only-depth claim
regression: RBF SVR epsilon=0.1, C=1/alpha; alpha in [0.01,0.1,1,10], bandwidth=training median squared distance times [0.5,1,2]; inner-validation native-score MAE selects one setting, test used for evaluation only
independent_dairy: Same fixed RGB feature recipe and train/validation/test cow-group splits, separate supervised calibration to the mean of two native dairy scores; source and target scores never merged or rescaled to one another
claims: DINOv2 and regional pooling are prior ideas. The episode-consensus construction and its controls form an application-specific candidate; effectiveness and anatomical meaning are empirical questions, not assumptions.
